image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is a translucent olive-green plastic. A yellow paper label is affixed to the top half, featuring handwritten or stamped red text that appears illegible/gibberish. Two circular spool hubs are visible through the clear plastic windows on the left and right. A rectangular window in the center reveals the dark magnetic tape. Small molded details like screw holes and ridges are visible on the lower plastic housing.
